description: Main activity class for managing app shortcuts, including adding, removing, enabling/disabling, and requesting pin shortcuts. Implements UI interactions and shortcut management logic.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, handling shortcut management and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, restores shortcuts, and handles intent actions.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Refreshes list and manages visible instances.

methods.name: onAddPressed
methods.description: Handles add button press to add a new website shortcut.

methods.name: onRequestNewPinPressed
methods.description: Handles request for creating a pinned shortcut.

methods.name: addWebSite
methods.description: Prompts user to input URL and initiates shortcut creation.

methods.name: addUriAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates shortcut for URL and updates UI or activity result.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks for enabling/disabling, removing, or requesting pin for shortcuts.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the shortcut's source types.
